title: EU Data Sharing Restrictions (GDPR Compliance)

sections.text: Notwithstanding the Global Data Sharing Policy, EU-based transfers of Dataset Y require explicit consent documentation and GDPR Article 46 compliance measures.
No Dataset Y containing EU resident personal data may be shared with any vendor without a Standard Contractual Clause (SCC) in place.
EU data transfers are prohibited to vendors in non-adequacy countries unless SCCs or Binding Corporate Rules are established.
The Analytics department may process EU-sourced Dataset Y internally without SCC but may not transfer to any external vendor without Legal and DPO approval.
EU data transfer requests must be reviewed by the Legal department and the Data Protection Officer (DPO) before any approval is granted. Review takes up to 15 business days.

source: Legal Compliance Register — EU GDPR Framework 2025
